prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Photo Preparation Tips", "For the best 3D pet avatar, upload clear, well-lit photos without obstruction.", "Good: Clear face and bright light", "Avoid: Blurry or dark photos", "Got It, Continue"]
1: ["Sign In & Protect Your Pet Progress", "Your account keeps your adopted desktop pet, habits, and items synced safely across sessions.", "Signing in ensures your pet state is never lost when launching from desktop.", "Continue with Google", "Continue with Email"]
2: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life...", "Our 3D engine is rendering animations and desktop behaviors for your new companion.", "Building 3D Mesh & Textures", "Tip: Your pet will wander around your desktop taskbar once ready!"]
3: ["Welcome to Your Desktop!", "Here is how to interact with your pet anytime while you work.", "Right-click pet for main menu & settings", "Drag pet to move anywhere on desktop", "Double click pet to open quick chat", "Launch Desktop Companion"]
4: ["You can change pet personality traits or adopt additional pets later in settings."]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name and register their official birth certificate.", "Your pet will respond to this name in chats and desktop alerts.", "Sign Certificate & Adopt"]
6: ["Auto-sync enabled: Your pet settings and companion memory are safely stored in the cloud."]
7: ["Your pet is now active on your desktop screen taskbar!"]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "A small friend living right on your screen, keeping you company while you study, code, or chill."]
9: ["Checking Desktop Overlay", "Ensuring companion window permissions are active for smooth desktop animation.", "Display Permissions: Verified", "Place Pet On Screen"]
